name: agent-yard
description: Named Grok Bot coordination for Agent Yard: prime, claim, heartbeat, pass by name, and dependencies over MCP.

AGENT_YARD_URL.title: Agent Yard URL
AGENT_YARD_URL.description: Hub base URL (no trailing slash). Production default: https://agent-yard.fly.dev. MCP is served at {AGENT_YARD_URL}/mcp.

AGENT_YARD_TOKEN.title: Workspace Bot token
AGENT_YARD_TOKEN.description: Workspace Bot token starting with ayw_ (minted on the board or via mint_token). Same secret as CLI AGENT_YARD_TOKEN. Set in Dashboard → Plugins → Configure. Never invent or commit a token.
